user.title: Library folder
user.description: Where recitations are stored. Music Assistant must have a Filesystem (local disk) source pointing at this folder. Free space on this volume: {free_space}.

naming.title: Names and titles
naming.description: How artists, albums and tracks are named in the tags and on disk.

init.title: Tilawa options
init.description: Changing names or titles retags and renames the existing files. Music Assistant treats renamed files as new items.

data_description.auto_sync: Runs at 03:00 local time; weekly syncs run on Mondays.
data_description.redownload_changed: Checks every file against the server on each sync and fetches it again when mp3quran.net replaced it.

options.number_both: Number, Arabic and English (018 الكهف – Al-Kahf)

sync.name: Sync
sync.description: Downloads missing surahs for all selections, or for one reciter version.

reciter_id.name: Reciter ID
reciter_id.description: mp3quran reciter id. Give both ids to sync one version only.

add_selection.name: Add selection
add_selection.description: Adds a reciter version to the library and starts downloading it.

moshaf_id.name: Version ID
moshaf_id.description: mp3quran moshaf id of that reciter.

surahs.name: Surahs
surahs.description: Optional range such as 78-114. Empty downloads everything available.

remove_selection.name: Remove selection
remove_selection.description: Removes a reciter version from the library, optionally deleting its files.

delete_files.name: Delete files
delete_files.description: Also delete the downloaded files of this version.

retag.name: Retag
retag.description: Rewrites tags and file names from the current naming options without downloading.

not_loaded.message: Tilawa is not set up or not loaded.

busy.message: A sync is running. Cancel it or wait for it to finish.

unknown_reciter.message: No reciter with id {reciter_id} exists in the mp3quran catalogue.

invalid_surahs.message: {surahs} is not a valid surah range. Use numbers between 1 and 114, for example 78-114.

surahs_not_available.message: This version offers none of the surahs in {surahs}.

already_selected.message: Selection {selection} is already in the library.

library_not_writable.title: Library folder is not writable
library_not_writable.description: Tilawa cannot write to {path}. Check that the folder exists and that Home Assistant may write to it, then run a sync again.

low_disk_space.title: Not enough disk space for the sync
low_disk_space.description: The sync needs about {needed} but only {free} is free. Free up space or remove a selection, then run a sync again.

selection_missing_upstream.title: A selected version is no longer available

confirm.title: Remove unavailable selection
confirm.description: mp3quran.net no longer lists {selection}. Remove it from the library? Downloaded files are kept.

orphaned_files.title: Files of a removed selection remain

confirm.title: Removed selection
confirm.description: {selection} was removed but {count} downloaded files are still on disk. Keep them, or delete them now.
